# Development Frameworks

Structured frameworks for building production-grade Shiny apps.

| Framework | Purpose | Key Feature |
|-----------|---------|-------------|
| **golem** | Production-grade app scaffold | Package-based structure, deployment helpers |
| **rhino** | Enterprise Shiny apps (Appsilon) | Box modules, Sass, Cypress E2E testing |
| **leprechaun** | Lightweight app scaffold | Minimal overhead, à la carte features |
| **Raw Shiny** | Small apps / prototyping | No framework overhead |

**Reference:** [Engineering Production-Grade Shiny Apps](https://engineering-shiny.org/) (the "golem book")

# Application Architecture

## Shiny Modules

- `moduleServer()` / `NS()` pattern for encapsulating UI + server logic
- Module communication: return values, shared reactive values, callbacks
- Nested modules and module composition patterns

## R6 Classes

- Mutable state management across modules via R6 objects
- Encapsulating business logic separate from Shiny reactivity
- Interface pattern for testability (swap implementations without changing UI code)

## Reactive Programming

- `reactive()`, `reactiveVal()`, `reactiveValues()`
- `observe()` vs `observeEvent()` — side effects and event-driven logic
- `isolate()` — breaking reactive dependencies
- `req()` — guarding against NULL / FALSE inputs
- `debounce()` / `throttle()` — controlling reactive event frequency
- `bindEvent()` — explicit event binding (Shiny 1.6+)
- Reactive graph mental model — understanding invalidation and flushing

## Theming

| Package | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| **bslib** | `bs_theme()` for Bootstrap variable customization |
| **thematic** | Auto-translates CSS theme to R plot defaults (ggplot2, base, lattice) |

## CSS Integration

- Custom stylesheets via `tags$link()` or `includeCSS()`
- Inline styles with `tags$style()`
- Sass preprocessing with the `sass` package or rhino's built-in Sass pipeline
- CSS specificity, Flexbox, Grid — enough to debug and override framework defaults

# JavaScript Integration

## Core Patterns

- `tags$script()` / `includeScript()` — injecting custom JS
- `Shiny.setInputValue()` — JS → R communication
- `Shiny.addCustomMessageHandler()` — R → JS communication
- Custom input/output bindings — full bidirectional widget control

## JS Libraries & Tooling

| Package / Tool | Description |
|----------------|-------------|
| **shinyjs** | Common JS operations without writing JS (show/hide, enable/disable, run JS) |
| **htmlwidgets** | Framework for wrapping JS libraries as R packages |
| **reactR** | Embed React components in Shiny |
| **crosstalk** | Linked brushing / filtering across htmlwidgets without server round-trips |
| **waiter** | Loading screens, spinners, progress indicators |
| **cicerone** | Guided tours of the app UI |

# Asynchronous & Parallel Programming

## Async in Shiny

| Package | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| **promises** | Promise-based async programming (`.then()`, `.catch()`) |
| **future** | Backend-agnostic parallel/async evaluation |
| **future.callr** | future backend using callr (separate R processes) |
| **callr** | Run R code in background processes |
| **crew** | Task orchestration / worker pools |
| **ExtendedTask** | Shiny 1.8+ built-in non-blocking task pattern |
| **mirai** | Minimalist async evaluation framework |

## Key Concepts

- `future_promise()` pattern — offload long computations without blocking other users
- `ExtendedTask$new()` — native Shiny async (recommended for new apps)
- Worker pool sizing and lifecycle management
- Progress reporting from async tasks

# Testing

## Unit Testing

| Package | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| **testthat** | Standard R unit testing framework |
| **shinytest2** | Automated Shiny app testing via headless Chromium |
| **testServer()** | Test module server logic without a browser |

## Integration / E2E Testing

| Tool | Description |
|------|-------------|
| **shinytest2** | Record-and-replay or scripted browser tests |
| **Cypress** | JS-based E2E testing (used by rhino) |
| **shinyloadtest** | Load/stress testing for Shiny apps |

## Testing Patterns

- Test business logic (R6 classes, pure functions) independently of Shiny
- `testServer()` for reactive logic without UI
- `shinytest2::AppDriver` for full integration tests
- Snapshot testing for rendered outputs (plots, tables)
- Mock data and dependency injection for reproducible tests

# Performance & Optimization

## Profiling

| Tool | Description |
|------|-------------|
| **profvis** | Visual profiler for R code |
| **reactlog** | Visualize the reactive dependency graph |
| **shiny.tictoc** | JS-based timing for Shiny render cycles |

## Caching

| Mechanism | Description |
|-----------|-------------|
| `bindCache()` | Cache reactive expressions and render outputs by key |
| **memoise** | Function-level memoization |
| **cachem** | Backend cache store (memory, disk) used by bindCache |

## Database & Data Layer

| Package | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| **pool** | Managed database connection pooling for Shiny |
| **DBI** | Database interface |
| **dbplyr** | dplyr backend for databases (lazy evaluation, server-side filtering) |
| **arrow** | Read/write Parquet, Feather — fast columnar data |
| **pins** | Publish and cache versioned datasets |
| **sparklyr** | Spark interface for large-scale data |

## Optimization Techniques

- Pre-aggregate data outside the app where possible
- `debounce()` / `throttle()` to limit reactive churn
- Pagination and server-side processing for large tables (DT)
- Minimize reactive dependencies — keep the reactive graph narrow

# Pharma-Specific Considerations

## Validation & Compliance

- GxP validation frameworks for Shiny apps (risk assessment, traceability, IQ/OQ/PQ)
- 21 CFR Part 11 awareness (audit trails, electronic signatures)
- Package validation: `riskmetric`, `thevalidatoR`
- Documenting intended use and testing evidence

## Clinical Dashboards

- CDISC data (SDTM/ADaM) as input — standardized data contracts
- Interactive patient profiles and safety review dashboards
- Subgroup filtering, cohort selection, drill-down patterns
- Export to validated formats (RTF tables, PDF listings)

## Pharma Shiny Ecosystem

| Package | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| **teal** | Roche's modular framework for exploratory clinical data analysis |
| **teal.modules.general** | General-purpose teal modules (scatterplot, histogram, etc.) |
| **teal.modules.clinical** | Clinical-specific teal modules (KM plot, forest plot, etc.) |
| **falcon** | FDA-sponsored Shiny safety reporting modules |
| **safetyGraphics** | Interactive safety graphics (labs, AEs) |
| **tidyCDISC** | Drag-and-drop CDISC data exploration app |
